name: Hindersche
description: Hindersche (meaning 'Backwards') is a rare and traditional reverse trick-taking game played exclusively in the central Black Forest of Germany. It is an Ace-Ten game where the objective is to *avoid* taking tricks containing card points. It is noted for its antiquity, using a 36-card pack and being played anticlockwise.

content.text: Hindersche (meaning 'Backwards') is a rare and traditional reverse trick-taking game played exclusively in the central Black Forest of Germany. It is an Ace-Ten game where the objective is to *avoid* taking tricks containing card points. It is noted for its antiquity, using a 36-card pack and being played anticlockwise.
A local game from the Kinzig and Wolf valleys. It is believed to be over 200 years old, traditionally played by farmers and foresters.
36-card German-suited pack (A, K, O, U, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6). Ranking: A > K > O > U > 9 > 8 > 7 > 6 > 10 (Note the low Ten!).
36-card German-suited pack (A, K, O, U, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6). Ranking: A > K > O > U > 9 > 8 > 7 > 6 > 10 (Note the low Ten!).
Play and dealing are ANTICLOCKWISE. Dealing varies but usually involves batches of cards to reach 9 cards per player.
